sources.title: Cascade Apex - AI-Powered Crisis Simulation
sources.snippet: Cascade generates a plausible scenario with a cast of AI-driven entities - media, regulators, employees, customers, adversaries - each with their own behaviours and motivations. Participants join a simulated workspace and the crisis begins. Injects arrive dynamically - emails, social media posts, news alerts, internal messages.

sources.snippet: Nvidia open sources its Cascade RL pipeline via NeMo-RL, enabling enterprises to achieve top-tier reasoning performance without building massive models from scratch. Nvidia has open-sourced the post-training pipeline behind its Nemotron-Cascade 2 model, signalling a shift in AI development where training methodology, rather than model size, defines performance.
